exact_statement: For finite uniform Boolean cubes and real K, b_K(n)=max_f(H(f)-K I(f)) is attained. Whenever any K-violation exists, choose least essential dimension n and maximize D_K over all n-bit truth tables: the chosen witness has positive deficit, all coordinates essential, every smaller Boolean phase and proper physical child nonviolating, and every same-dimensional vertex edit nonimproving. For any Boolean f, entropy potential G_f=sum fhat(S)log2(fhat(S)^2)chi_S, and vertex subset E of density delta, H(f^E)-H(f)>=4 E[1_E f G_f]-(8/ln2)delta, and I(f^E)-I(f)=(2/2^n)sum_boundary(E)f(x)f(y). If b_K(n)-D_K(f)<=epsilon, then sum_E f G_f <=(K/2)sum_boundary(E)f(x)f(y)+(2/ln2)|E|+2^n epsilon/4. In particular exact selected witnesses obey f(x)G_f(x)+K p_f(x)<=Kn/2+2/ln2. Proper-cut deficits retain the exact physical telescope and finite child cap b_K(n-|A|). No infinite-dimensional optimizer, automatic reduction-invariance, paid-block selection or full FEI bound is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite uniform Boolean signs, entropy in bits, zero spectral potential terms defined as zero
Real K; epsilon>=0 for finite additive-deficit tolerance
Critical phase/child eligibility requires least essential dimension among all Boolean K-violators
Boundary edges undirected; vertex edits may retain the same dimension and are not physical restrictions
